KEEPITREEL

BEFORE YOU INSTALL

Good questions.

Can it tell if something was made by AI?

KeepItReel identifies supported AI disclosures and specific warning patterns. It cannot reliably determine the origin of arbitrary text, images or video. Unlabelled content stays origin unknown.

Does green mean an email is safe?

No. Green on a supported opened message means the enabled checks found no matching warning patterns. Inbox previews contain less information and may show a neutral, limited-check indicator. Attachments, malware and sender authentication are not verified.

Does it read my entire inbox?

No. When you enable email checks, KeepItReel checks supported visible inbox previews and opened messages in Gmail and Outlook. It does not connect to a mailbox API or fetch full unopened messages in the background.

Can I use it on my phone?

This release is for desktop Chrome. The website works on mobile, but the extension does not protect native phone apps.

Will it stay free?

All current features are free. Optional support helps fund development. Any future paid features would be clearly described and would require a separate choice; a contribution does not purchase a subscription.
